translation_notes: RDF.type / PROF.Profile / OWL.Ontology become rdf:type / prof:Profile / owl:Ontology; the region is a read-only lookup, so nothing else changes

the source's 14-name 'from rdflib.namespace import (...)' is namespace scaffolding for the whole file and is replaced by the three @prefix declarations the region uses; 'from rdflib import Dataset, Graph, Literal, URIRef' is kept, Graph and URIRef being used in the signature
the draft placed the @prefix lines inside the parenthesised import list, which is not a statement position; they are moved out

the error messages mention prof:Profile and owl:Ontology inside f-strings: string contents stay opaque to the island parser, so those stay plain text (checked: both sides raise the identical ValueError message)
driver: only the two returning branches are exercised, the harness aborting on any exception; the two raising branches were checked separately to produce identical ValueError messages on both sides
